decisions.because: Counterexample (hunt round 3, 2026-10-10): with an operator ban on the target, RETRACT answered 'OK lifted' (INTEGRATIONS.md: nothing else held the block) while it stayed blocked; 'too many known claims' was answered 'OK refused protected'.

statement: A detector retraction is answered OK lifted only when nothing blocks the target on this node any more; a block still held by an operator, static or peer claim is answered as still held. A capacity refusal of a signal is answered as a capacity refusal, never as a protected target.
